policy.automatic: Mutating Rust work enters rust-workflow, which builds a current-change ProfileStack with one owner per decision unit, construct-bound coding profiles, and trigger-bound helpers. Read-only control-plane skills may enter directly.
policy.negative: A Rust keyword alone does not require a workflow for small general-knowledge questions, and non-Rust tasks must not route to this plugin.
policy.overlays: rust-coding-rules runs after decision ownership is established, selects at most nine rules per active decision unit, and never occupies a ProfileStack role.
